title: Async-RBench: Benchmarking Asynchronous Task Execution in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.32429v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute tasks asynchronously: a main agent continues working while its subagents run, and the task state may change before their results arrive. The main agent must decide which work to update or preserve and which checks to repeat, while avoiding prohibited changes. Final task success alone does not reveal whether these results were handled correctly, and natural asynchronous arrivals are hard to reproduce. We introduce Async-RBench, a benchmark for asynchronous task execution in LLM agents, with 200 executable tasks covering eight scenarios. A scenario controller regulates result delivery using predefined task-state conditions, while an Event Response Contract (ERC) specifies what each response must change, preserve, avoid, and re-verify. The Dynamic Replanning Score (DRS) weights the response process and outcome equally and is reported separately from task success. We evaluate nine agents

translated_title: Async-RBench：面向LLM智能体异步任务执行的基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地以异步方式执行任务：当其子智能体运行时，主智能体继续工作，而任务状态可能在结果到达之前发生变化。主智能体必须决定哪些工作需要更新或保留、哪些检查需要重复，同时避免执行被禁止的更改。仅凭最终任务是否成功无法揭示这些结果是否被正确处理，而自然的异步到达过程又难以复现。我们提出了Async-RBench，一个用于评估LLM智能体异步任务执行的基准，包含200个可执行任务，覆盖八种场景。场景控制器使用预定义的任务状态条件来调控结果的交付，而事件响应契约（ERC）规定了每个响应必须更改、保留、避免和重新验证的内容。动态重规划得分（DRS）对响应过程和结果赋予同等权重，并与任务成功率分开报告。我们评估了九个智能体。
tldr: 该论文提出了Async-RBench，一个包含200个可执行任务的基准，通过事件响应契约（ERC）和动态重规划得分（DRS）独立评估LLM智能体在异步任务执行中处理动态变化结果的能力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Async-RBench, a benchmark with 200 executable tasks that evaluates how LLM agents handle asynchronous task execution, using an Event Response Contract (ERC) to specify required responses and a Dynamic Replanning Score (DRS) reported separately from task success.
